name: metricforge-performance-training-and-kpi-simulation-lab
description: MetricForge is a KPI simulation and performance training platform for estimating metrics, interpreting thresholds, improving decision quality, and tracking team readiness.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.audit:check: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high
